title: Cross-layer capability register and evidence-derived delivery metrics
body:
## Mission reconciliation — 2026-11-12

Parent: #81. Capability IDs: `MTR-METRIC-01`.

CLI-219..235 define the old 300-item metric system and AUG-056 covers scorecards; neither currently includes this mission-wide four-layer capability crosswalk. Add a child under #81 or extend an agreed existing issue.

## Acceptance

- [x] Machine-readable mission rows cover every requested feature and map to existing CLI/DCP/WEB/AUG issues.
- [x] Preserve the 300-item seed and its frozen weights; separate inventory coverage, partial implementation, code-complete, tested, merged, deployed and accepted counts.
- [x] Validate IDs, references, evidence/version/layer bindings and dependencies; stale evidence cannot silently award current acceptance.
- [x] Readable dashboard/report derives metrics from evidence and clearly separates overlapping catalogs and unknown/unverified states.

## Dependencies and overlap

Implementation prerequisites: No new issue prerequisite; preserve existing authorization controls.

Reuse/cross-link: #81, #136.

## Evidence and closure

The November 12 audit distinguishes standalone CLI main, the MTechLabs-Access 53-tool production bridge, the separate staging gateway and canonical ChatGPT plugin. PR #249 is an unmerged reconciliation candidate at creation time. Implementation, tests, merge, deployment and full acceptance are separate states. Preserve the CLI-300/DCP-48/WEB-12/AUG-117 denominators. Require scoped failing/passing tests, independent review and exact candidate/main gates; no full acceptance from issue creation or tool advertisement.

## Qualified source delivery — 2026-11-12

PR #257 merged at `f447c0baac3f36470d6fd96360928c6a2a192c4b`, tree `cbb3b682c4bfdf472bdfbc1ebfce5cd2e71174fc`, after independent review and six successful exact-candidate checks. The actual merge tree equals the reviewed candidate and retains the expected base/head parents.

All six fresh actual-main jobs passed in [fast run43304263686](https://github.com/MulattoTech/MTerm-CLI/actions/runs/43304263686) and [compatibility run43304263698](https://github.com/MulattoTech/MTerm-CLI/actions/runs/43304263698), attempt1. Windows passed1,395/1,395; other source lanes passed1,383 with12 Windows-only skips. All five package gates passed24 installed-profile,31 synthetic isolation-protocol and18 provenance tests. Four real Codex0.160.1 registration/shutdown lanes and12 source+12 installed native scenarios passed with zero model calls.

The checked register covers143 product requirements,272 feature bullets,488 mission bullets and11 governance groups. Every product row has issue ownership; the CLI300/DCP48/WEB12/AUG117 catalogs retain separate denominators. Original stages/weights and complete/tested/merged/deployed/accepted product counts are preserved independently from this register delivery.

The initial merge timeout/405 was resolved by one controlled normal retry after more than two hours and fresh exact-head/base/check verification. No force/ref update, rule bypass or candidate change was used. Independent actual-main receipt SHA256: `6abf0091556faf97745c66932ddad8f8ae7360580ee28fbee3cda2067b0404d7`; six complete logs total5,024,994 bytes and the45-file native artifact digest was verified.

This completes the scoped source register and validation issue. Parent #81, broader product acceptance, deployed portal behavior and ongoing evidence reconciliation remain separate. No production deployment or acceptance of the143 product requirements is implied.
